Sepulchre of Dragrimmar level 2 }}__NOTOC__ [[Remnant of Antiquities]] is the final guardian of the [[Sepulchre of Dragrimmar]]. ==Locations== *[[Depths of Tyria]] **{{NPC location|Sepulchre of Dragrimmar}} ==Quests== * [[The Anvil of Dragrimmar]] * [[Remnant of Antiquities (Zaishen quest)]] ==Skills== 16 [[Water Magic]] *{{skill icon|Deep Freeze}} *{{skill icon|Frozen Burst}} *{{skill icon|Ice Spikes}} *{{skill icon|Shatterstone}} ([[elite]]) *{{skill icon|Water Attunement}} *{{monster skill icon|Diamondshard Mist}} ==Notes== *The [[Diamondshard Mist (environment effect)|Diamondshard Mist effect]] looks like a [[Ward]]. For 10 seconds, it reduces movement speed by 33%, after which it ends, causing the [[Diamondshard Grave]] effect, which inflicts 140 damage and causes [[Bleeding]] for 10 seconds. *Diamondshard Grave can be mostly eliminated by using the skill [[Diversion]] against [[Diamondshard Mist]]. *Defeating this foe will spawn a [[Dragrimmar Chest]]. *See [[The Anvil of Dragrimmar#Walkthrough|The Anvil of Dragrimmar quest page]] for a guide to defeat this foe. *This foe seems to have at least +6 natural [[health regeneration]], instead of +3. *In [[Hard mode]], this foe is immune to the [[Dazed]] condition, but he may still be [[knocked down]].
